figures.caption: Fig. 1. ThinkNet methodology. In fold-specific search and gating, source data support normalization, validation, and selection without held-out-subject feedback. Fixed unsupervised signal cleaning is applied without labels or model feedback.
Fig. 3. Validation-gated ensemble selection. Validation logits choose the policy; held-out logits are applied only after the gate is fixed.

Fig. 4. (A) Fold-seed distributions show large subject-shift variation. (B) Accuracy–size trade-off shows compact models in the high-accuracy region. (C) Subject profiles show that several held-out subjects remain difficult across decoder families.

Fig. 5. Search and selection reliability. (A) Candidate landscape; test accuracy is post hoc and never used for selection. (B) Selected-family distributions. (C) Seed-averaged subject results for validation-selected versus non-deployable test-best family accuracy; vertical lines mark uniform-choice expectation and fixed-family EEGNet.

Fig. 6. Validation-gated analysis. (A) Policy means and subject-level 95% CIs. (B) Compact-six gains after averaging seeds within each held-out subject. (C) Summary. The positive mean gain varies by subject.
